Health Functional FoodNiacin 7.2mgVitamin B1 0.97mgVitamin B2 1.68mgVitamin C 180mgVitamin E 13.32mgPantothenic acid 4.4mgOnce a day

멀티비타민Niacin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Pantothenic acid

Made by 태웅식품(주) · Once a day · 4 tablets

This product combines 7.2mg of Niacin, 0.97mg of Vitamin B1, 1.68mg of Vitamin B2, 180mg of Vitamin C, 13.32mg of Vitamin E, 4.4mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (4 tablets): 7.2mg Niacin, 0.97mg Vitamin B1, 1.68mg Vitamin B2, 180mg Vitamin C, 13.32mg Vitamin E, 4.4mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 태웅식품(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day4 tablets per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (7.2mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.97mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.68mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin C labelled (180mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (13.32mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Pantothenic acid labelled (4.4mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Appearance 연보라색의 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 2년

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
